title: •After Her!
caption: •After Her! (V)
game_text: Plays on table. Unless she is present at a site, {set:reflections3} Leia’s game text is canceled. Each Amidala stacked on a Political Effect is a senator. Once per game, may ▲ {ovs:3} Astromech Shortage.

notes: Unique. Printed base is an Immediate Effect (Theed Palace); slip banner DEFENSIVE SHIELD. Inline icons: before 'Leia’s' a blue disc with a dark figure holding a red double-bladed saber = the Reflections III set icon → {set:reflections3} (GEMP VB text: '[Reflections 3] Leia'); before 'Astromech Shortage' a tan/white striped sphere = the Original Virtual Set 3 sphere (matches ovs-set-3.png; Astromech Shortage (V) is VS3) → {ovs:3} (GEMP: '[Virtual Block 1] Astromech Shortage'). The wiki stub drops both icons and expands ▲ as 'Take into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle'. Curly apostrophe in Leia’s. Lore corrected from scan: curly single quotes ‘This one’s a decoy!’ (wiki straight 'This one's a decoy!'). Only a 350 px scan exists; copyright '© 2001 LUCASFILM LTD. & TM. TM, ® & © 2001 DECIPHER INC.' just legible on it. Modern: no V-remake; the Virtual Block DS reissue (350 px, res.starwarsccg.org legacy VirtualBlockDS-Dark/afterher.gif) downloaded as src/vs14/modern/18-VBDS-D-afterher.gif. Art: printed scan by its measured Episode I window (art.rect; the old trim zoomed in — Bill 2026-10-14).
